levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Sorts fewer than half the items correctly.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Sorts at least five of six items correctly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Sorts all six correctly and explains the reasoning for the one trickiest item.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Items are folded or hung but shapeless, for example stretched or crumpled.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Folded items are neat and hung items fit their hangers.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Neat and consistent, and the learner names one thing they checked to keep the item’s shape.

lookFors: Fold edges are visibly straight, not just bunched.
Hangers match the item's shoulder width.
Confidence rating is tied to a specific item, not vague.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
